OpenAI is reportedly pulling major customers away from Anthropic with aggressive discounts, and the strategy is working. Companies like Rippling, Replit, and DataCamp are shifting more of their AI spending to OpenAI, The Information reports. Rippling CEO Parker Conrad said his company boosted OpenAI's share of its coding workload from 16 to 52 percent, while Anthropic's share fell from 57 to 18 percent.

Replit switched after OpenAI offered more than 30 percent off a contract worth over $100 million a year. DataCamp CEO Jonathan Cornelissen said OpenAI's pricing cut his costs by 80 to 90 percent. A US bank with more than $7 billion in assets got its ChatGPT seats doubled to 500 employees at no extra charge, paying under $7 per user instead of the usual $20 or more.

OpenAI is partly buying market share at the expense of its own margins, but it has also achieved real price cuts through its Sol and Luna model lines thanks to more efficient models and infrastructure. Anthropic's growth slowed from Q2 to Q3, according to an investor memo. Both companies also face growing price pressure from China, where new models by Deepseek and Kimi deliver comparable performance for a fraction of the cost.

translation.html:
据报道，OpenAI 正通过大幅折扣从 Anthropic 手中争夺大客户，而且这一策略正在奏效。据 The Information 报道，Rippling、Replit 和 DataCamp 等公司正将更多 AI 支出转向 OpenAI。Rippling 首席执行官 Parker Conrad 表示，该公司已将 OpenAI 在其编程工作负载中的占比从 16% 提高到 52%，而 Anthropic 的占比则从 57% 降至 18%。

OpenAI 为一份年价值超过 1 亿美元的合同提供了超过 30% 的折扣，随后 Replit 转而选择了 OpenAI。DataCamp 首席执行官 Jonathan Cornelissen 表示，OpenAI 的定价使其成本降低了 80% 至 90%。一家资产超过 70 亿美元的美国银行无需额外付费，就将 ChatGPT 席位翻倍，覆盖 500 名员工，每位用户支付不到 7 美元，而通常的价格为 20 美元或更高。

OpenAI 在一定程度上正以牺牲自身利润率为代价换取市场份额，但凭借效率更高的模型和基础设施，其 Sol 和 Luna 模型系列也实现了实质性降价。一份投资者备忘录显示，Anthropic 的增长从第二季度到第三季度有所放缓。两家公司还面临来自中国的日益加剧的价格压力，Deepseek 和 Kimi 的新模型以低得多的成本提供了相当的性能。
